LABORATORY EXPERIMENT PROTOCOL

Step-by-Step Procedure

Step 1: Choose Two Prime Numbers (p, q)

Navigate to the Simulation page. Enter two distinct prime numbers $p$ and $q$ (e.g., $p = 11, q = 13$ or $p = 61, q = 53$). The system will instantly check primality and distinctness.

Step 2: Calculate Modulus (n) and Euler's Totient φ(n)

Observe the computed values:
$n = p \times q$   |   $\phi(n) = (p - 1)(q - 1)$

Step 3: Choose Public Exponent (e)

Input your chosen public exponent $e$ such that $1 < e < \phi(n)$ and $\gcd(e, \phi(n)) = 1$. You can also pick from the dynamically suggested coprime chips.

Step 4: Compute Private Exponent (d)

The simulator executes the Extended Euclidean Algorithm to calculate $d = e^{-1} \bmod \phi(n)$ such that $e \cdot d \equiv 1 \pmod{\phi(n)}$. Key pairs $(e, n)$ and $(d, n)$ are generated.

Step 5: Enter Plaintext Key Number (M)

In the Workbench, enter a numeric plaintext key $M$ ensuring $0 \le M < n$ (e.g., $M = 4$ or $M = 65$).

Step 6: Perform Encryption and Decryption

Click "Encrypt & Decrypt Key Live" to compute:
Ciphertext: $C = M^e \bmod n$
Decryption: $M' = C^d \bmod n$
Verify that $M' = M$.

Step 7: Execute Test Suite

Click "Run All Test Cases" in the Automated Verification Test Suite to validate multiple prime configurations.
